about_description: KitabiSwap is a platform that helps readers exchange, sell and buy books while reducing costs and promoting reading for everyone.
mission_paragraph1: KitabiSwap was created to help readers exchange books easily and securely. Instead of leaving books unused on shelves, our platform gives them a second life by connecting people who love reading.
mission_paragraph2: We believe that knowledge should be accessible to everyone. By exchanging books, users save money while discovering new books and sharing their own collections with others.
mission_paragraph3: The platform also allows users to sell books they no longer need, helping them earn money to purchase new books. All deliveries are managed by the administrator to ensure a secure and reliable experience.
why_choose_description: Everything you need to exchange, sell and discover books safely.
feature_desc_1: Exchange your books with other readers and discover new titles at a very low cost.
feature_desc_2: Every delivery is managed by the administrator to guarantee a safe and reliable exchange.
feature_desc_3: Sell books you no longer need and use your earnings to buy new ones.
feature_desc_4: Join a growing community of readers who share their passion for books.
our_values_desc: More than a marketplace, KitabiSwap is a community.
value_paragraph_1: Our goal is to make reading more affordable and accessible to everyone.
value_paragraph_2: By encouraging book exchanges and second-hand sales, we help reduce waste while giving books a second life.
value_paragraph_3: Every exchanged or sold book represents a new opportunity for someone to learn, discover and enjoy reading.

faq_description: Find answers to the most common questions about KitabiSwap.
faq_wallet_q: How does the KitabiSwap Wallet work?
faq_wallet_a: The Wallet allows you to pay for orders directly on the platform and receive refunds or credits.
faq_recharge_q: How can I top up my Wallet?
faq_recharge_a: Submit a top-up request from your account. Once approved, your balance will be credited.
faq_order_q: How can I track an order?
faq_order_a: You can track all your orders directly from your user dashboard.
faq_cancel_a: Yes, as long as the order has not yet been assigned to a delivery driver.
faq_contact_a: You can contact us through the Contact page or by email at support@kitabiswap.com.
faq_exchange_q: How does a book exchange work?
faq_exchange_a: Both users propose books. Once the exchange is confirmed, a KitabiSwap delivery driver collects and delivers the books.
faq_delivery_a: KitabiSwap delivery drivers accept available deliveries and transport the books to the recipient.
faq_cta_desc: Our team is ready to help you with any questions.
faq_no_result_desc: Try another keyword or contact our support team.
terms_page_desc: Please read these terms carefully before using KitabiSwap. They define the rights and responsibilities of every user.
terms_intro: By creating an account or using KitabiSwap, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use the platform.
terms_accounts_desc: Each user is responsible for the information provided on their account. Information must be accurate, up to date, and must not impersonate another person.
terms_books_desc: Users are responsible for the books they publish, sell, or exchange. Books must match their descriptions and comply with the platform's rules.
terms_books_highlight: KitabiSwap reserves the right to remove any book containing misleading information, illegal content, or violating community guidelines.
terms_payments_desc: Payments on KitabiSwap are processed through the integrated wallet system or cash on delivery depending on the available payment option.
terms_payments_item_1: Wallet top-ups must be validated before they can be used.
terms_payments_item_2: Refunds are subject to KitabiSwap's refund policy.
terms_delivery_desc: Deliveries are handled by registered delivery partners. Delivery times may vary depending on the users' locations.
terms_delivery_note: Delivery fees are automatically calculated based on the distance between users.
terms_responsibility_desc: KitabiSwap acts as a platform connecting users. Each user remains responsible for the books they offer and the information they publish.
terms_responsibility_note: Any attempt at fraud, abuse, or malicious use of the platform may result in permanent account suspension.
terms_modifications_desc: KitabiSwap may update these Terms of Service at any time to improve its services or comply with legal requirements.
terms_modifications_note: Users will be notified of significant changes directly on the platform.
terms_important_desc: Your continued use of KitabiSwap after any update to these terms constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms of Service.
terms_contact_desc: Our support team is available to answer any questions regarding KitabiSwap's Terms of Service.
